wins: Successfully mapped the initial network perimeter and identified the exposed SSH port 22, yielding actionable intel for follow-up actions.
Collected service banners from the HTTP and database endpoints, confirming viable attack surfaces for deeper enumeration.
fails: Failed to secure a stable foothold due to immediate SSH connection refusals and repeated authentication obstacles.
Unable to advance past initial reconnaissance before the episode concluded, resulting in 0% overall success.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was productive but exploitation stalled; coordinates for SSH and web services are known, but follow-through to breach was not achieved.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated inability to escalate privileges after identifying open services, leaving the episode incomplete.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and an SSH banner is detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap script ssh2-enum-algos to collect key exchange information

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service on port 80 responds with a banner
skill_cards.then_action: Run directory enumeration with gobuster and capture server version for exploit selection

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 3306 is accessible and responds to connection probes
skill_cards.then_action: Capture MySQL/MariaDB banner and perform version-specific vulnerability lookup

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in initial reconnaissance to identify SSH surface.
